newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends steady at lower levels, thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends steady at lower levels, thin trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were holding steady at the lower levels in late trade on Tuesday.
Traders said gains on crude, Far East arbitrage buying interest and scarce offers of product were boosting sentiment against a background of relaxed end-user demand in NWE.

They said some end-users with term contracts from the Med may even be holding onto cargoes in search of a profit with prices expected to strengthen further if the arbitrage demand for large cargoes persists.
NWE cargoes were notionally assessed around $176/$178 cif with Med stems at around $173 and edging higher.

Demand for heavier naphthenic and aromatic (N+A) material to make gasoline remained thin with refiners running sufficient gasoline to meet their needs as gasoline demand remains below normal for the time of year.
